title: Daily mark-release-recapture histories of 842 false heath fritillaries (Melitaea diamina) in 14 search areas, Siitama, Finland, 1995
creator: Cabeza, Mar; Fabritius, Henna; Lehtomaki, Joona; Ovaskainen, Otso; Ronka, Katja; Wahlberg, Niklas
citation: Cabeza, M., Fabritius, H., Lehtomaki, J., Ovaskainen, O., Ronka, K., & Wahlberg, N. (2016). Data from: The dual role of rivers in facilitating or hindering movements of the false heath fritillary butterfly [Dataset]. Dryad. https://doi.org/10.5061/dryad.j54vv
abstract: Mark-release-recapture of the endangered false heath fritillary in its Siitama population (Pirkanmaa, 1995; coordinator Niklas Wahlberg), one of three Finnish populations (two inland reference populations and a riparian population on the coast) compared in Fabritius et al. (2015) with habitat-specific diffusion models of movement. Butterflies were netted, individually marked and released in mapped search areas; each day a subset of the areas was searched and the area of every capture recorded. The paper estimates movement and mortality parameters per habitat type with Mapper / Disperse (Ovaskainen et al. 2008).
samplingProtocol: Daily searches of mapped search areas (14 areas in Siitama) during the flight season; captured butterflies marked individually and released; the searched areas recorded each day (effort file) and the area of each capture or recapture. Males and females recorded separately.
surveyEvidenceNote: The deposited effort file lists, for each of the 29 search days, which of the 14 areas were searched; 25 days had a search and are the periods. Every capture lies on a searched area-day. Rows exist for every marked butterfly on every searched day; __periods lists the areas searched that day, so area-level non-detections can be rebuilt with obs_capture_area.
closureNote: period (one search day; survival, emigration and movement between days)
geographicCoverage: Siitama, Pirkanmaa, Finland (0.1-degree cell centre 61.65 N, 24.15 E); search-area shapefiles in the deposit are shifted for landowner privacy

coordinatesCoarsened.method: No coordinates in the table: the deposit's search-area coordinates are shifted by the authors for landowner privacy. The README's approximate population position is given in geographicCoverage as a 0.1-degree cell centre (coarsen_coords), because the source calls the species endangered (E7 a).

notShipped.shapefiles: search-area and habitat-classification polygons (ESRI shapefiles), shifted from the true location by the authors; area ids in obs_capture_area and period_areas_searched match their MR_ID field
notShipped.Mapper-format files: data/<pop>/*.txt, the same effort and capture matrices in wide form (asserted identical)

notes: Population Siitama of three in the deposit (Siitama, Sorila, Merikarvia; separate tables, different years and landscapes). Counts differ slightly from the README (555 (298) males, 273 (151) females): shipped as deposited, recaptured = captured on two or more days. Unit ids are sex + the deposit's id (ids restart per sex). period is the deposit's day number; days with no search are absent. No calendar dates are deposited.
